# Project Boundary

- [ ] This keeps Aetherion local-first and does not make a UI, connector, generated package, browser extension, IM adapter, cloud worker, or projection into a trust root.
- [ ] This does not add GUI, mobile, real IM delivery, browser automation, MCP/OAuth connectors, cloud workers, or generated-code execution to V1 scope.
- [ ] This does not store raw secrets, credentials, private data, raw prompt text, raw model output, or sensitive traces.
